reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down Ecolab, a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions that protect people & the resources vital to life. As of this recording. My guest is Todd Wenning, founder of KNA Capital Management, who has a knack for finding interesting businesses.

key_points.text: We get into Ecolab's very on-brand origin story, how the business kept that core focus throughout its history.
Please enjoy this Breakdown on Ecolab.
